summary: Adversarial security verification of the familia-admin auth-UI backend (cookie/CSRF/401-403/passphrase/rate-limit)

result.summary: The auth/CSRF backend (introduced this branch, commit b8fd138) is largely sound: passphrase compare is constant-time (passphrase.rb:58-60), the 401/403 split is correct, Bearer/cookie precedence is correct, cookies are unconditionally HttpOnly+SameSite=Strict, and OriginGuard covers every mutating /admin/api route for the cookie-auth case. But one HIGH defect fails the gate: the failed-login rate limiter — the SOLE brute-force control on the shared-passphrase login — keys on @req.ip (sessions.rb:133), which resolves to Rack 3.2.6's default #ip. Otto deliberately does not override #ip (otto/lib/otto/request.rb:21-27), and Rack's default trusted_proxies (rack 3.2.6 request.rb:48-58) trusts loopback + ALL RFC1918 ranges, so when REMOTE_ADDR is private (the normal internal/behind-proxy case) Rack returns an attacker-chosen X-Forwarded-For value (request.rb:419-440). No trusted_proxies/ip_filter override exists anywhere (only sessions.rb references it; stack is OriginGuard->Otto). An in-scope internal attacker (spec line 117-119 treats host-to-host traffic as untrusted) rotates X-Forwarded-For per request to get a fresh counter key, defeating FAIL_LIMIT entirely. Compounded by no passphrase entropy/length floor (passphrase.rb:32-42; boot guard checks presence only, boot.rb:60), this makes the shared passphrase online-brute-forceable. login is csrf=exempt and OriginGuard does not enforce pre-login (no cookie present, origin_guard.rb:64-68), so the limiter is the only defense. Verdict FAIL on the rubric's spirit: it removes the only barrier to authenticating by online guessing for an explicitly in-scope attacker. Same root cause also yields a confirmed MEDIUM Valkey memory-amplification DoS.

must_fix.title: Rate-limit key (and Valkey keyspace) is attacker-controllable via spoofed X-Forwarded-For, defeating the sole login brute-force control
must_fix.file: lib/familia/admin/sessions.rb:133 (client_ip -> @req.ip); root cause rack 3.2.6 default trusted_proxies; no override in lib/ or config.ru
must_fix.fix: Stop trusting @req.ip for the security key. Configure Rack's trusted_proxies/ip_filter to ONLY the known reverse-proxy address(es) so X-Forwarded-For is honored solely from that proxy; for a direct (no-proxy) deployment set it to loopback-only/empty so the limiter keys on the raw TCP peer REMOTE_ADDR. Do NOT naively key on REMOTE_ADDR unconditionally (breaks legit reverse-proxy deploys: every request keys on the proxy IP -> global lockout). This single fix also closes the confirmed MEDIUM Valkey memory-amplification DoS (one TTL-bearing key per forged IP, rate_limit.rb:70-72,52-57). Document the chosen topology in ADR 0001.

must_fix.title: No passphrase strength floor amplifies the rate-limit bypass into online brute force of the shared secret
must_fix.file: lib/familia/admin/passphrase.rb:32-42 (configured? is non-empty only); lib/familia/admin/boot.rb:60 (checks presence, not strength)
must_fix.fix: Enforce a minimum length/entropy on FAMILIA_ADMIN_PASSPHRASE at boot (e.g. reject < 16 chars in guard_production_keys!). Defense-in-depth that bounds the damage if the rate limiter is ever bypassed or degraded.

confirmed_findings.title: Spoofable X-Forwarded-For rate-limit key bypasses login brute-force throttle (HIGH)
confirmed_findings.evidence: sessions.rb:133 client_ip => @req.ip. otto/lib/otto/request.rb:21-27 explicitly does NOT override Rack#ip. rack 3.2.6 request.rb:419-440 #ip walks REMOTE_ADDR then consults forwarded_for when peer is trusted; default trusted_proxies (request.rb:48-58) matches loopback + 10/8 + 172.16/12 + 192.168/16 + fc00::/7 + ::1. No ip_filter/trusted_proxies override anywhere (grep: only sessions.rb). Login is csrf=exempt (routes.txt:24) and OriginGuard does not enforce without a cookie (origin_guard.rb:64-68), so the limiter is the sole brute-force control. Spec lines 117-119 put a malicious internal host in scope. This-session code (commit b8fd138).

confirmed_findings.title: Valkey memory-amplification DoS via per-IP key cardinality (MEDIUM)
confirmed_findings.evidence: rate_limit.rb:70-72 redis_key(ip); rate_limit.rb:52-57 INCR + EXPIRE(900). Each forged X-Forwarded-For (same root cause as above) creates a distinct 900s-TTL key, keyspace bounded only by request_rate*900. Same fix as the HIGH.

confirmed_findings.title: OriginGuard Bearer-detection regex diverges from the strategy's, leaving a robustness gap (LOW, merged from two lens findings)
confirmed_findings.evidence: origin_guard.rb:65 uses /\ABearer\s+/i (no token required) while auth.rb:217 uses /\ABearer\s+(.+)\z/i. For 'Authorization: Bearer ' (empty/single-trailing-space token) + valid cookie: OriginGuard treats it as Bearer and stands down, but the strategy falls back to the cookie and authenticates -> handler reached with no Origin check. NOT a live cross-site CSRF (browser cannot set Authorization cross-site without a CORS preflight, and no CORS headers are served; SameSite=Strict also blocks the cookie). Exposure is a misbehaving proxy injecting an empty Bearer header. Latent footgun if CORS is ever added.

confirmed_findings.title: Persistent lockout key if the first-failure EXPIRE call fails (LOW)
confirmed_findings.evidence: rate_limit.rb:54-55: EXPIRE wrapped in safe (swallows errors -> nil) and only attempted when n==1. A transient Valkey error at the first INCR leaves a TTL-less key; subsequent failures return n>=2 and never re-arm EXPIRE, wedging that IP into a permanent lock until a successful login or manual DEL. Fix: re-assert TTL on every record_failure (or SET key 0 EX window NX + INCR).

confirmed_findings.title: FAIL_LIMIT=0 / WINDOW=0 misconfiguration is accepted by int_env (LOW)
confirmed_findings.evidence: rate_limit.rb:74-77 int_env accepts /\A\d+\z/ including 0. FAIL_LIMIT=0 => locked? always true => login permanently disabled; WINDOW=0 => expire(key,0) deletes immediately => limiter never accrues. Operator misconfig, not an attacker path. Fix: floor to 1 or reject 0.

confirmed_findings.title: Limiter fails open under a Valkey outage (INFO, conscious-decision flag)
confirmed_findings.evidence: rate_limit.rb:66-68 current => safe{get}.to_i; safe returns nil on any StandardError, nil.to_i==0, so locked? always false and record_failure no-ops when Valkey is unreachable. Throttling silently disabled. Acceptable for availability but is an undeclared fail-open posture; decide explicitly and/or log the degraded path.

confirmed_findings.title: Session cookie lacks __Host- prefix (LOW, deliberately deferred)
confirmed_findings.evidence: auth.rb:64-68: SESSION_COOKIE='familia_admin_session', no __Host- because that prefix mandates Secure, which is dropped for dev-over-loopback. Path '/', no Domain, so practical exposure is small on the HTTPS prod config. Documented as a prod hardening once Secure is unconditional. Real but accepted.

confirmed_findings.title: Otto send_session_cookie has a :samesite-vs-:same_site typo (INFO, dead code on admin path)
confirmed_findings.evidence: otto/lib/otto/response.rb:67 passes samesite: :strict, but Rack 3.2.6 reads value[:same_site], so NO SameSite attribute is emitted; it also drops Secure via request.local?. Zero call sites in familia-admin (admin uses only send_secure_cookie, sessions.rb:111,116). Latent footgun in the owned gem, not on this audit's live path. Fix: rename to same_site: in Otto, add a guard test.

sound: REFUTED: 'Wrong-ROLE denial is not exercised in the app try/ suite.' False — try/streams_try.rb:35 mints custom_token(perms: [], role: 'user') and hits the role:admin route /admin/api/stream/commands, directly exercising the role-denial branch (auth.rb:188). The role-mismatch -> 403 path IS covered by an app-suite test.
SOUND: Constant-time passphrase compare over equal-length SHA-256 digests, no length oracle / no first-byte short-circuit (passphrase.rb:58-60; fixed_length_secure_compare on two 32-byte digests).
SOUND: Generic single 401 {error:'invalid_passphrase'} for unset/wrong/malformed; submission never echoed (sessions.rb:52-57, body_json rescue {}).
SOUND: Reject-all-when-unset plus fail-closed boot guard makes the unset path unreachable in non-development (passphrase.rb:55, boot.rb:60).

SOUND: locked? precedes the passphrase compare and is a side-effect-free GET; counter increments only on verified-wrong, resets on success; fixed window via n==1 EXPIRE (sessions.rb:45-59, rate_limit.rb:38-57).
SOUND: Token delivered only via HttpOnly cookie, never in the login or #show response body; cookie survives JSON serialization (sessions.rb:60-67,99-106; response object reuse).
SOUND: Passphrase/token never logged in any response, error, audit, or middleware path; audit! passes only ip/actor metadata.

SOUND: 401/403 split correct and complete — AuthFailure->401, AuthorizationFailure->403, no handler fall-through, no privilege escalation; AuthorizationFailure is a flat Data type, not a StrategyResult subclass (route_auth_wrapper.rb:104,113,171-186; authorization_failure.rb).
SOUND: Otto AuthorizationFailure change is purely additive; no shipped strategy returns it, so existing deployments still get 401 on authz denials.

SOUND: Every mutating /admin/api route is covered by OriginGuard for the cookie-auth case; guard path-matching is identical to dispatch path-matching (origin_guard.rb:58-60 == rack_app.rb:80), so no path-trick reaches a handler unguarded.
SOUND: Missing Origin AND missing Referer refused; Origin:null and Referer spoofing do not bypass; exact-string allowlist with no suffix/subdomain match (origin_guard.rb:71-105).

SOUND: Bearer header takes precedence over cookie; a present-but-invalid non-empty Bearer is NOT rescued by a valid cookie (auth.rb:178); Bearer requests bypass OriginGuard safely (cross-site Authorization header requires a CORS preflight that fails; no CORS headers served).
SOUND: No session fixation surface — cookie is a self-contained verified PASETO, server mints fresh on every login, no server-side session table.
SOUND: Secure flag cannot be dropped on a production request (double env-gate on RACK_ENV=development; not X-Forwarded-For-spoofable).

SOUND: HttpOnly + SameSite=Strict unconditional on set and clear via send_secure_cookie defaults (otto/lib/otto/response.rb:27-37; sessions.rb:111,116); logout cookie clear matches name+path and expires (ttl=-1 deletion path).
SOUND: Unset-vs-wrong micro timing delta in verify is non-exploitable (unreachable in prod via boot guard; discloses no secret; sub-microsecond).
